rules.name: hv-cluster-contention-high
rules.query: Perf | where Computer == "HV-HOST-01" and ObjectName == "Hyper-V Hypervisor Virtual Processor" and CounterName == "CPU Wait Time Per Dispatch" and InstanceName contains ":" | extend Guest=tostring(split(InstanceName,":")[0]) | where Guest in ("WIN2019-GUEST","WIN2022-GUEST","WIN2025-GUEST-01") | summarize Value=percentile(CounterValue,95)

rules.name: hv-cluster-cpu-critical
rules.query: Perf | where Computer in ("WIN2019-GUEST","WIN2022-GUEST","WIN2025-GUEST-01") and ObjectName == "Processor Information" and CounterName == "% Processor Time" and InstanceName == "_Total" | summarize MemberCPU=avg(CounterValue) by Computer | summarize Value=avg(MemberCPU)

rules.name: hv-cluster-cpu-high
rules.query: Perf | where Computer in ("WIN2019-GUEST","WIN2022-GUEST","WIN2025-GUEST-01") and ObjectName == "Processor Information" and CounterName == "% Processor Time" and InstanceName == "_Total" | summarize MemberCPU=avg(CounterValue) by Computer | summarize Value=avg(MemberCPU)

rules.name: hv-cluster-memory-critical
rules.query: Perf | where Computer in ("WIN2019-GUEST","WIN2022-GUEST","WIN2025-GUEST-01") and ObjectName == "Memory" and CounterName == "Available Bytes" | summarize MemberMemory=100.0*(1-avg(CounterValue)/8589934592.0) by Computer | summarize Value=avg(MemberMemory)

rules.name: hv-cluster-memory-high
rules.query: Perf | where Computer in ("WIN2019-GUEST","WIN2022-GUEST","WIN2025-GUEST-01") and ObjectName == "Memory" and CounterName == "Available Bytes" | summarize MemberMemory=100.0*(1-avg(CounterValue)/8589934592.0) by Computer | summarize Value=avg(MemberMemory)

rules.name: hv-windows-memory-critical
rules.query:
let capacity=datatable(Computer:string,Bytes:real)["HV-HOST-01",68719476736.0,"SQL2019-GUEST",12884901888.0,"WIN2019-GUEST",8589934592.0,"WIN2022-GUEST",8589934592.0,"WIN2025-GUEST-01",8589934592.0];
Perf | where ObjectName == "Memory" and CounterName == "Available Bytes" | summarize Available=avg(CounterValue) by Computer | join kind=inner capacity on Computer | project Computer,Value=100.0*(1-Available/Bytes)
